COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET

CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
7A.
City of Cerritos dated July 26, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated July 26, 2012 in the total amount of $2,684,228.62.
7B.
Successor Agency dated July 26, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

8A.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting of July 9, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting minutes of July 9, 2012.
End of Consent Calendar
9.
Public Hearings
9A.
A request by applicant Perkowitz & Ruth Architects, 111 West Ocean Boulevard, 21st Floor, Long Beach, California, on behalf of the property owners for approval to remodel the existing buildings of The Fountain Plaza shopping center; replace a demolished, fire-damaged two-story building with a new two-story building; refurbish and upgrade the existing fountain, landscaping, and hardscape; and make improvements to vehicular and pedestrian circulation. The subject property is located at 11440-11510 South Street, Cerritos, California, 90703 and is zoned Regional Commercial (CR) (APN 7039-021-050). (COUNCIL)
Precise Plan 76-22(A)(2012) Amendment*
*Pursuant to sections 15301 and 15302 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
1. Approve Precise Plan 76-22(A)(2012) Amendment, making the findings set forth in Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-24.
2. Determine, under Cerritos Municipal Code Section 22.9.050(c)(2), that the subject new two-story commercial and office building (Building B), except for the additional square footage (10% of the total valuation of Building B), is exempt from the fees for the Art in Public Places Program.
10.
New and Old Business
10A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE CITY OF LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA, REGARDING THE EXCHANGE OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS FOR GENERAL FUNDS FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013. (COUNCIL)
1. Authorize the City Manager to execute all documents necessary to complete the exchange of the City of Cerritos’ FY 2012-2013 CDBG Fund allocation with the City of La Mirada for not less than 0.71 on the dollar in General Fund Monies; and,
2. Waive reading of and adopt a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos captioned as follows: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE CITY OF LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA, REGARDING THE EXCHANGE OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS FOR GENERAL FUNDS FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013.
10B.
Consideration and award of a design services contract for the construction of a Cerritos Library teen area, 18025 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos (APN 7025-028-907). (COUNCIL)
award a design services contract to CWA AIA, Inc. in the amount of $31,250 for the construction of a teen area in the Cerritos Library.
10C.
Review and consideration of discounted green fees on Veteran’s Day at Cerritos Iron-Wood Nine Golf Course. (COUNCIL)
1. Review the information contained in the staff report.
2. Approve the Parks and Recreation Commission’s recommendation to offer a fifty percent discount on green fees for all military veterans on Veteran’s Day, beginning November 11, 2012.
11.
Legislative Items
11A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
11B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
11B 1. Review and consideration of pending legislation and taking action regarding same if appropriate - Senate Bill 1387 (Emerson): Proposed legislation to prohibit a junk dealer or recycler from possessing manhole covers, backflow devices and fire hydrants without written certification from the owner of the material. (COUNCIL)
concur with the League of California Cities to support SB 1987, direct staff to prepare a letter addressed to the Assembly Appropriations Committee and Senator Emerson stating said support with copies to Senator Lowenthal, Assemblymember Mendoza, League of California Cities, California Contract Cities and Joe A. Gonsalves & Sons.
11B.
Review and consideration of sending a letter to the State Department of Parks and Recreation in support of the City of Whittier and other cities seeking reimbursement for city funds spent to keep state parks open.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
13.

A.

Adjourment
